android_mechanism: OUI CSV import commits each row separately; fix batches all inserts into one transaction
bug_description: The dataset-sync page imports the classic-poem dataset by iterating the parsed JSON array and issuing one standalone RDB INSERT per poem (each in its own autocommit transaction, all fired concurrently via a non-awaited map). Importing thousands of rows generates thousands of individual journal/fsync cycles, saturating the DB writer and freezing the sync page for a long time.
fix_summary: Dataset import uses RdbStore.batchInsert so the whole array is inserted in a single transaction; the per-row debug logging is removed.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

mechanism_oracle.definition: Time from dataset JSON parse completion to the last INSERT commit observed in disk/database trace activity.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed: one sqlite journal/fsync cycle per row (thousands of small commits); fixed: single batched commit. unfixed_import_ms > fixed_import_ms by >= 3x for a multi-thousand-row dataset.

reproduction: git -C hosts/jingmo checkout case/jingmo_dataset_import_no_transaction/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/jingmo checkout case/jingmo_dataset_import_no_transaction/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
